_comment: Curated meaning for the GL tables. Appended to the LLM-written descriptions by kg/build_graph.py so the SQL lane understands them.

tables.FEATURE: EXPOSURE level. One row per claimant x coverage on a claim (FEATURE_TYPE BI, PD or MedPay). Reserves, payments and coverage decisions hang off FEATURE, not CLAIM: join CLAIM -> FEATURE -> RESERVE_STATE / PAYMENT.
tables.RESERVE_STATE: VERSIONED reserve history, bitemporal. One row per reserve revision; rows are never updated. IS_CURRENT = 1 marks the latest. VALID_FROM/VALID_TO is when the amount applied; RECORDED_AT is when the carrier learned it. 'Reserve as known on D (valid on V)': RECORDED_AT <= D AND VALID_FROM <= V, take the row with the latest VALID_FROM then RECORDED_AT.
tables.LITIGATION: One row per suit on a claim. An OPEN suit has STAGE <> 'closed' (stages: filed, discovery, trial, closed). ATTORNEY_ID is the counsel on the suit.
tables.PAYMENT: One row per payment on a FEATURE. PAYEE_ID can point at ANY party table; the prefix tells which: CLT- claimant, ATT- attorney, MP- medical provider. RUN_ID links to the ingestion run that produced it.
tables.CLAIM: Claim header. A claim is carrier-handled when ADJUSTER_ID is set and TPA-administered when TPA_ID is set. OCCURRENCE_ID can be shared by several claims arising from the same loss event.
tables.CLAIMANT: Injured or damaged party. ATTORNEY_ID = counsel representing them, PROVIDER_ID = treating medical provider (both may be NULL).
tables.EXTRACTED_FACT: Facts extracted from document text by a model. CONFIDENCE is 0-1; treat >= 0.7 as reliable. MODEL_VERSION and RUN_ID give lineage. FACT_TYPE 'pre_existing_condition' marks pre-existing condition mentions. Path to a claim: EXTRACTED_FACT -> TEXT_CHUNK -> DOCUMENT -> CLAIM.
tables.TEXT_CHUNK: A passage of a DOCUMENT. EMBEDDING_MODEL is NULL until the vector step has embedded it.
tables.INJURY: Injury sustained by a claimant. INJURY_CLASS is soft_tissue, fracture, laceration or head_injury.
tables.OCCURRENCE: The loss event. LOCATION_ID is the premises where it happened; premises with 3+ occurrences are repeat-loss locations.

columns.RESERVE_STATE.IS_CURRENT: 1 = the latest revision for the feature; 0 = superseded. Use IS_CURRENT = 1 for the current reserve.
columns.FEATURE.FEATURE_TYPE: Values: BI (bodily injury), PD (property damage), MedPay (medical payments, coverage C).
columns.CLAIM.LOB: Always CGL (commercial general liability) in this dataset.
columns.COVERAGE_PART.CODE: A = Bodily Injury & Property Damage, B = Personal & Advertising Injury, C = Medical Payments.
columns.LITIGATION.STAGE: Values: filed, discovery, trial, closed. Open = anything except closed.
columns.OCCURRENCE.CAUSE_OF_LOSS: Values: slip_and_fall, trip_hazard, falling_object, product_liability, food_borne, parking_lot, dog_bite, assault.
